integrity: Analytical proof provided; exact-rational finite checker supports but does not replace all-size proof. Originality comparison has explicitly noted accessible-source limitations.
scientific_limitations: Only complete bipartite graphs and lower open-neighborhood medians; one-input ratio, not two-input Lipschitz; edge weights only in variation; full text of one plausible graph-median paper not available.
title: Sharp weighted-variation amplification for neighborhood medians on complete bipartite graphs
